raw_response:
I am 76 years old and have farmed in Quzhou County for 55 years. I finished middle school, so I can read fertilizer labels and do my own accounts. My farm is 21.4 mu, which is more than my wife and I can manage alone at our age, so I hire workers for transplanting chili and picking cotton. This year I am keeping the same layout as last year: 8 mu in wheat-maize rotation, 5.4 mu chili, and 8 mu cotton.

For the winter wheat already in the ground since last October: I used one 50 kg bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu as base, and I will top-dress with 25 kg urea at green-up in March. That comes to about 18 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, and 7 kg potassium per mu. I will irrigate three times — before winter freeze, at green-up, and at heading. Two pesticide sprays should handle the aphids and rust. I rotary-tilled before planting. If the spring drought does not get too bad, I expect 550 kg per mu.

For summer maize planted right after wheat harvest in June: I always use hybrid seed, and I plant no-tillage directly into the wheat stubble. I spread 40 kg compound and 20 kg urea per mu — about 15 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, 6 kg potassium. Summer rain usually helps, but I irrigate twice, at jointing and flowering, if it stays dry. Two pesticide applications. I expect 650 kg per mu.

For the 5.4 mu chili: I plant an improved variety and transplant in early May. Chili needs a lot of potassium or the fruit skins get thin. I put down 50 kg chicken manure and 40 kg compound per mu, plus 15 kg potash fertilizer. That is about 15 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, 15 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate four times because chili wilts easily, and spray three times for mites and rot. Rotary tillage. I expect 2,000 kg fresh chili per mu.

For the 8 mu cotton: hybrid cotton seed, planted in late April. I use 50 kg compound and 15 kg urea per mu, plus a little extra potash — about 14 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, 10 kg potassium. Cotton needs water at flowering and boll-setting, so three irrigations. Three pesticide sprays for bollworm. Rotary tillage. I expect 280 kg seed cotton per mu.

I sat down with my accounts last month. Fertilizer and pesticide will cost me around 12,000 yuan for all 21.4 mu. That is a big outlay, but I remember 2013 when I tried to save 500 yuan on fertilizer and lost two whole mu of wheat. Never again. My neighbor Li uses about the same rates, and his yields are steady. I would rather put down a bit too much than wake up to yellow leaves.
